facts.text: Rule one for night guards, eat before your shift starts. Rule two, save some snacks for Rexy.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Larry's words, but he never says it. In the film Cecil hands Larry a manual that Dexter later destroys, and Larry tames Rexy by throwing a bone. I could not open a quote page for this pass (the search tool was out of budget), so there is no quote source.
facts.fix: Rule one, eat before your shift. Rule two, keep a bone handy for Rexy.

fix_note.text: Rule one, eat before your shift. Rule two, keep a bone handy for Rexy.

facts.text: Some men are born great, says Teddy.
facts.why: Teddy Roosevelt says 'Some men are born great' to Larry in the film, and repeats it the next night.

facts.text: Dum Dum the Easter Island head
facts.why: In the film the Moai calls Larry 'dum-dum' and asks him for 'gum-gum'. The head is never called Dum Dum, so the name is backwards.

vibe.verdict: A cosy museum cafe with the right exhibits and the bone game, but the dishes are generic cafe food with a museum label.
